units.rawText: Caretaker, did you learn something you shouldn't again? It's not like this is the first time...
units.displayText: Caretaker, did you learn something you shouldn't again? It's not like this is the first time...

spans.text: Caretaker, did you learn something you shouldn't again? It's not like this is the first time...

units.rawText: Oh, no need to go out of your way to forget it. You've grown used to how weird I am, right? Just like how I know you ought to be the "Professor", but I keep calling you "Caretaker" instead.
units.displayText: Oh, no need to go out of your way to forget it. You've grown used to how weird I am, right? Just like how I know you ought to be the "Professor", but I keep calling you "Caretaker" instead.

spans.text: Oh, no need to go out of your way to forget it. You've grown used to how weird I am, right? Just like how I know you ought to be the "Professor", but I keep calling you "Caretaker" instead.

units.rawText: It's okay if you know about mysterious things like how Miss Bunny and Arctic Fox are actually artificial creations like me…
units.displayText: It's okay if you know about mysterious things like how Miss Bunny and Arctic Fox are actually artificial creations like me…

spans.text: It's okay if you know about mysterious things like how Miss Bunny and Arctic Fox are actually artificial creations like me…

units.rawText: Speaking of which, I'm sure you'll have no problem living with me in the zoo, Caretaker.
units.displayText: Speaking of which, I'm sure you'll have no problem living with me in the zoo, Caretaker.

spans.text: Speaking of which, I'm sure you'll have no problem living with me in the zoo, Caretaker.

units.rawText: Even if I never learn the truth regarding the mysterious things about me, that's okay... I think.
units.displayText: Even if I never learn the truth regarding the mysterious things about me, that's okay... I think.

spans.text: Even if I never learn the truth regarding the mysterious things about me, that's okay... I think.

units.rawText: <color=#DE8AC7>"I'm hungry!"</color> It seems it's feeding time for Miss Bunny. Shall we get her and Arctic Fox something to eat? Actually... I'm also hungry.
